title: Gnome World: Which Parts Are Hazel
blurb: Which parts of Gnome world are Hazel and which JavaScript, asked of event handling, physics, the world's state and the drawing. Hazel decides what the world is and how the gnome moves: the plan from a seed, the gnome's step 60 times a second (0.016 ms a call, compiled by hazel-jit), the beavers' minds, the villagers' words, the roots. JavaScript holds all the state (nine arrays of 186,368 tiles), takes the input, runs everything else that moves (the water is 2.2 ms of a 2.4 ms step) and draws it all: 92% of the code, 70% of it drawing. Clover the rabbit is Hazel's gnome step with JavaScript around it. Since 0.0.107 the magic carpet's flight is Hazel's too, the first piece of a plan to move the logic over piece by piece, each piece checked against the JavaScript it replaces and timed.
